features: Motion Detection Alerts, This camera detects movements in the video frame and send alerts in real-time to always keep you noted about what’s happening at home.
360° View, The camera rotates full 360°, making it convenient for you to view the room from every angle and keep an eye all over the place even when you are away from home.
View & Talk, Enables you to stay in touch with your loved ones from anywhere, meaning you can also talk while viewing the live video feed on the phone.

Supports Motion Tracking, Whenever unexpected motion is detected in the video frame, the camera has been devised to rotate automatically to track the movement of people and record it to investigate later.
3MP Resolution, Designed to represent an enhanced picture quality in full HD video so that every detail can be viewed with vivid clarity and a pixilated video feed can be avoided.

BIS-ER (STQC Certified) Smart WiFi CCTV Camera for Trusted Security The Trueview 3MP Robot Camera is BIS-ER (STQC Certified), ensuring compliance with Indian government standards for safety, performance, and data protection. Designed for reliable use in homes, offices, and commercial spaces.

3MP HD Resolution (2304×1296) for Clear & Detailed Video Monitoring Capture every detail with 3MP high-definition video quality, enabling clear identification of faces, movements, and activities for effective surveillance.

ATC (All Time Colour) Night Vision with Smart & Infrared Modes Experience full-colour night vision even in low light and darkness. The camera supports All Time Colour, infrared, and intelligent night modes, ensuring 24/7 visibility.
360° Coverage with 352° Pan & 58° Tilt Rotation Monitor a wider area with pan tilt functionality, offering 352° horizontal and 58° vertical movement, reducing blind spots and enhancing coverage.

AI Human Detection, Motion Detection & Smart Auto Tracking Advanced AI-powered detection accurately identifies human movement and reduces false alerts. The smart tracking feature automatically follows moving subjects and sends real-time alerts to your mobile.

Full Duplex Two-Way Audio for Real-Time Communication Equipped with a built-in microphone and speaker, this two-way audio CCTV camera allows seamless communication with family members, staff, or visitors.
Multi-Device Monitoring via Mobile, PC & Web CMS (TrueCloud Plus) Access live view and playback anytime using Android, iOS, Windows, and web CMS, ensuring complete remote monitoring from anywhere.
